answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The island counter is kept in tundra and comet reveals each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1692 identities would post 1612 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
